covered.label: LA Metro Rail (A, B, C, D, E, K)
covered.detail: 110 of 110 stations on the six Metro Rail lines, live departures. Three D Line stations west of Wilshire/Western (Wilshire/La Brea, Wilshire/Fairfax, Wilshire/La Cienega) are in the app but show no service until the new timetable starts on 1 November; the app detects this automatically from the published timetable and says so instead of showing a blank board, and resumes live departures by itself when service starts.

covered.label: Metrolink
covered.detail: Live departures at Union Station (AV, VC, OC, 91-PV, RIV, SB lines — GTFS stop 107) and Pomona North (SB Line only — GTFS stop 109). Requires METROLINK_API_KEY. Shown in a separate direction group on the same station board; Metro Rail boards render even if the Metrolink feed is unavailable.

covered.label: Amtrak Pacific Surfliner
covered.detail: Live departures at Union Station only (Amtrak stop_id LAX). Route 78 only via the transitdocs GTFS-RT feed (https://asm-backend.transitdocs.com/gtfs/amtrak, keyless). Three direction chips: Pacific Surfliner + San Diego, Pacific Surfliner + Goleta Amtrak, Pacific Surfliner + San Luis Obispo. Shown in a separate direction group on the same station board; Metro Rail and Metrolink boards render even if the Surfliner feed is unavailable. Long-distance Amtrak (Coast Starlight, Southwest Chief, Sunset Limited, Texas Eagle) is excluded — compulsory reservation. Tim approved this feed on 25 Oct 2026.

notCovered.label: Amtrak long-distance trains (Coast Starlight, Southwest Chief, Sunset Limited, Texas Eagle)
notCovered.detail: Excluded - booking a seat is compulsory.

notCovered.label: Metro G Line and J Line busways, Metro buses
LAX airport shuttles and people movers

stations: 110 Metro Rail stations; Metrolink at Union Station and Pomona North.
notes: 7th St/Metro Ctr is the A x B x D x E hub; Union Station, Civic Ctr/Grand Park, Pershing Square and Historic Broadway are separate stations, not the same stop.
